name: Guangdong Insight Brand Marketing Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Insight Brand Marketing Group Co.,Ltd. is a prominent marketing agency operating across China, specializing in comprehensive brand management solutions. Their extensive service portfolio begins with strategic consulting, which includes tailored brand strategy research and development, innovation guidance, business model design, as well as in-depth trend analysis and market forecasting. Beyond strategy, they deliver core brand management services, encompassing detailed brand planning, integrated marketing communication (IMC) strategy formulation, and the creative production of all marketing content. In the digital sphere, Guangdong Insight excels in integrated digital marketing, featuring talent (influencer) marketing, interactive digital media planning and creative execution, and private domain community operation. Finally, their offerings extend to public relations and media agency services. Established in 2002, the company maintains its headquarters in Guangzhou, China.
